title: Constant-coefficient realization commutes naturally with right tensor
statement: Let T be a scheme and A a commutative ring. Let E be the canonical realization from sheaves valued in A-modules to module sheaves over the constant commutative ring sheaf, using constant-scalar extension and canonical coefficient-ring transport [lem-weil-pbc-etale-constant-ring-module-equivalence, lem-pur-site-constant-module-hom]. For every A-module sheaf F, there is a natural isomorphism E followed by the sheafified right tensor with E(F) to right tensor with F followed by E [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. It is natural in the variable module sheaf; no flatness or morphism of schemes is assumed.

source.place: Sections 03EK, 093I and 03CV; the tensor universal property together with the constant-scalar extension equivalence.

proof.text: Encode constant-scalar module-valued presheaves as modules over the constant ring presheaf. The encoding identifies sectionwise tensors by the identity on pure tensors. The canonical locally bijective coefficient-ring map identifies module sheafification with constant-scalar realization: the map is the identity on underlying abelian sheaves, and the sheafification counit is invertible. Apply the natural module sheafification tensor comparison of lem-sf-proetale-sheafification-tensor-comparison in both factors. Compose it with the monoidal comparison and invertible counit of ordinary module-valued sheafification. This gives a natural tensor comparison in both factors; fixing the second factor gives the stated right-tensor comparison.

theorem etaleConstantModule_tensorRight_comparison (T : Scheme.{u})
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    (F : Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) :
    Nonempty (etaleSumTensorTestRealization T A ⋙
      SheafOfModules.siteSheafTensorRight.{_, _, _, u + 1} (J := T.smallEtaleTopology)
        (A := (constantSheaf T.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj
          (CommRingCat.of A)) ((etaleSumTensorTestRealization T A).obj F) ≅
      tensorRight F ⋙ etaleSumTensorTestRealization T A)
